title: Mijn dag — week 2 op een rij
summary: Recap of numbers, time, V2 and questions, then mijn verhaal layer 2: your daily routine

blocks.title: Week 2, on one page
blocks.body: Look how much you can already do: **count** to a hundred with the reversed tens (*vierentwintig*), **tell time** including the *half zes* trap, keep the **verb in slot 2**, and **ask questions** by inversion. Today you braid it all into your own daily routine.
blocks.callout: The new skill this week that unlocks everything later: V2. Guard that slot-2 verb.

blocks.explain: Unit first: *acht* (8) + *en* + *zestig* (60) = 68. The reversed tens, still tricky, still one word.

blocks.prompt: It's 8:30. Write the time in Dutch.
blocks.hint: *half* looks forward to the next hour.
blocks.explain: *half negen* = 8:30. Halfway to nine, not half past eight.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence keeps the verb in slot 2 correctly?
blocks.explain: Front the time, verb second, subject behind it: *'s Avonds kook ik thuis.* The first breaks V2; the third has the wrong ending.

blocks.prompt: Turn 'Jij werkt in Utrecht' into a yes/no question.
blocks.hint: Verb first, and the -t drops behind jij/je.
blocks.explain: *Werk jij in Utrecht?* Verb to the front, and *jij* triggers the -t drop.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type the price you hear.

items.en: In the morning I drink coffee.
In the afternoon I eat a sandwich.
In the evening I cook at home.

blocks.title: Build a routine sentence — mijn verhaal, deel 2
blocks.prompt: Front a time expression, keep the verb in slot 2, subject behind it. This is the routine layer of your self-intro.
blocks.sample: Om acht uur begin ik met werken.

blocks.scene: Emma wants the full tour of your new daily rhythm

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: Vertel eens, hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?
lines.en: Tell me, what does your day look like?

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: 's Ochtends drink ik koffie en om negen uur werk ik.
lines.en: In the morning I drink coffee and at nine I work.
lines.spotlight: Two V2 clauses, both with the verb safely in slot 2.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: En 's avonds? Wat doe je dan?
lines.en: And in the evening? What do you do then?
lines.spotlight: *Wat doe je* — question word, verb, -t drop.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: 's Avonds kook ik en soms zie ik vrienden.
lines.en: In the evening I cook and sometimes I see friends.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.target: Wat gezellig! Je Nederlands wordt echt goed, hoor.
lines.en: How lovely! Your Dutch is getting really good, you know.

questions.q: What does the learner do at nine o'clock?

blocks.title: Mijn verhaal — deel 2
blocks.prompt: Write your growing self-intro. Keep last week's layer (name, where you're from, that you're learning Dutch) and add your daily routine: present tense, verb in slot 2, at least one time expression.
starters: Ik ben … en ik kom uit …

blocks.prompt: Two weeks in — proost! What clicked this week, and what still feels raar? Write a line or two, in Dutch if you can.
